generate_dialogue_actions: run generate_dialogue.py with -n 100 to generate 100 action trees and language pairs
generate_composite_actions: run generate_dialogue.py with --composite_action flag to generate only composite action sequences
generate_non_composite_actions: run generate_dialogue.py with --no_composite_actions flag to generate only single action sequences
generate_actions_with_ranges: run generate_dialogue.py with --length_range 1 10 and --width_range 1 5 to constrain action dimensions
generate_actions_with_files: run generate_dialogue.py with --mob_file and --block_types_file to load custom entity names
